name: Yume o Mou Ichido: Koufuku no Kaze
original_name: 夢をもう一度　幸福の風
source:
Sasaki Hitomi is a full-on career woman who works for a foreign advertising agency. Though the business department had progressed ahead with preparations for a new project, a major advertising company "Kokusendou" created issues by snatching away clients. 

In order to deal with Kokusendou, a new department was established. Hitomi and her peers were transferred into this new department. Even so, Nakata hadn't stopped passionately going after Hitomi, Akimoto continued to be a jerk and the Kongou brothers' carefree ways hadn't changed!

One day, Hitomi was made to work alongside Akimoto despite their dismal terms with one another being well-known in the agency. However, they meet Aihara Kiichi, who introduced himself as Kokusendou's business department manager and he declared war with them. Nakata's marriage proposal only made things even more complicated during such chaotic times.

What will become of Hitomi and the agency?

[Translation of official website story summary.]
translation:
佐佐木瞳是一名就職於外商廣告公司的幹練職業女性。業務部原本正在籌備新案子，大型廣告公司「國宣堂」卻橫插一腳，搶走客戶，製造了不少麻煩。

為了應對國宣堂，公司成立了新的部門，瞳和同事們也被調到這個新單位。即便如此，中田依舊熱烈追求著瞳，秋元仍然是個討厭鬼，金剛兄弟隨心所欲的作風也絲毫未變！

一天，儘管公司上下都知道瞳與秋元關係惡劣，兩人卻還是被安排共同工作。隨後，他們遇見了自稱國宣堂業務部長的相原喜一，對方當場向他們宣戰。就在這片混亂之中，中田又突然求婚，令事態變得更加複雜。

瞳與這家廣告公司究竟會迎來怎樣的命運？

[翻譯自官方網站的故事簡介。]
